# 274.00 CAD out of the bank against a 100.00 USD invoice — 200.00 USD of
# receivable closed, so 100.00 USD more than the document is owed.
#
# The transaction's currency is CAD and the receivable's is USD, so the residue
# this leaves is a USD credit parked on a USD account under a CAD transaction:
# the shape where labelling a credit with its transaction's currency calls
# 100.00 USD "CAD 100.00", and the per-owner totals then add it to that
# customer's real CAD credits.
2026-02-25 * "FX Customer — overpayment for INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 274.00 CAD
		memo: "Payment for INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -200.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
